Mainbreaker_QA1
has tripped. We kindly request you to coordinate a site intervention for this charger. Please adhere to the troubleshooting steps outlined in the attached document. Additionally, if feasible, arrange for spare components so that if the current ones are damaged, we can replace them and restore the charger to operational status.
Additionally, please find below knowledge article for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_Braeker,QA1_Mainbreaker QA1 error - Dynamics 365

Pick

Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [03/07/2024]
,
as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.

afonso-sousa@siemens.com

.
